comparison_scope: Source-bound local contract/code-gap comparison plus synthetic input/negative-control tests. No real task, authenticated authority, comparative reliability, latency, or monetary cost study was performed.
findings: The receiver-handoff preflight validates receipt-to-bundle projection and declared receiver preconditions, but does not connect a local ExecutionPacket, approval request/decision, execution lease, task-state revision, and receiver adapter version into one exact binding check.

The execution-effect receipt addresses generic caller-declared run/source/input/output and later observation bindings, optionally checking local file bytes; it does not validate this Federation handoff/action/authorization/receiver contract.
The producer-consumer semantic preflight checks bounded literal text patterns and relations; it does not bind execution authority or receiver compatibility.

The new tool specializes in one exact handoff action and composes the existing receipt/receiver preflight with packet, authorization, lease, source/task revision and adapter-version comparisons. It does not replace any compared tool.

All records, revisions, descriptors, observations and approval values remain caller supplied. The positive and adversarial evidence is synthetic only; real-task benefit and comparative cost are unknown.
The local clock comparison catches a caller-supplied lease whose ACTIVE status conflicts with its declared issue/expiry window; it does not authenticate the lease issuer or state.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Before a receiver handoff, compare the same exact pending action, source revision, task-state revision, target artifact digest, approval decision ID, packet digest, execution lease and receiver interface version across the existing local record types.
Fail closed when a caller-declared handoff needs native resume or an external-session-reference kind that the supplied receiver descriptor does not declare.

retirement_decision.basis: C1 matched-scope inspection identifies distinct complementary contracts; no replacement or retirement is supported. Keep this candidate default-off and preserve uncertainty about real-task value and cost.

cost.basis: No comparable latency, token, resource, operator-effort, or monetary measurements were collected.
